entries.title: Job 29:1
segments: ¶Moreover Job continued his parable, and said, {continued: Heb. added to take up}

entries.title: Job 29:2
segments: Oh that I were as [in] months past, as [in] the days [when] God preserved me;

entries.title: Job 29:3
segments: When his candle shined upon my head, [and when] by his light I walked [through] darkness; {candle: or, lamp}

entries.title: Job 29:4
segments: As I was in the days of my youth, when the secret of God [was] upon my tabernacle;

words.text: As I was in the days

entries.title: Job 29:5
segments: When the Almighty [was] yet with me, [when] my children [were] about me;

entries.title: Job 29:6
segments: When I washed my steps with butter, and the rock poured me out rivers of oil; {me: Heb. with me}

entries.title: Job 29:7
segments: ¶When I went out to the gate through the city, [when] I prepared my seat in the street!

entries.title: Job 29:8
segments: The young men saw me, and hid themselves: and the aged arose, [and] stood up.

entries.title: Job 29:9
segments: The princes refrained talking, and laid [their] hand on their mouth.

entries.title: Job 29:10
segments: The nobles held their peace, and their tongue cleaved to the roof of their mouth. {The nobles...: Heb. The voice of the nobles was hid}

words.text: to the roof of their mouth
. {The nobles...: Heb. The voice of the nobles was hid}

entries.title: Job 29:11
segments: When the ear heard [me], then it blessed me; and when the eye saw [me], it gave witness to me:

entries.title: Job 29:12
segments: Because I delivered the poor that cried, and the fatherless, and [him that had] none to help him.

words.text: , and [him that had] none to help

entries.title: Job 29:13
segments: The blessing of him that was ready to perish came upon me: and I caused the widow's heart to sing for joy.

words.text: of him that was ready to perish
upon me: and I caused the widow's

entries.title: Job 29:14
segments: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me: my judgment [was] as a robe and a diadem.

entries.title: Job 29:15
segments: I was eyes to the blind, and feet [was] I to the lame.

entries.title: Job 29:16
segments: I [was] a father to the poor: and the cause [which] I knew not I searched out.

entries.title: Job 29:17
segments: And I brake the jaws of the wicked, and plucked the spoil out of his teeth. {the jaws: Heb. the jawteeth, or, the grinders} {plucked: Heb. cast}

words.text: . {the jaws: Heb. the jawteeth, or, the grinders} {plucked: Heb. cast}

entries.title: Job 29:18
segments: ¶Then I said, I shall die in my nest, and I shall multiply [my] days as the sand.

entries.title: Job 29:19
segments: My root [was] spread out by the waters, and the dew lay all night upon my branch. {spread...: Heb. opened}

entries.title: Job 29:20
segments: My glory [was] fresh in me, and my bow was renewed in my hand. {fresh: Heb. new} {renewed: Heb. changed}

entries.title: Job 29:21
segments: Unto me [men] gave ear, and waited, and kept silence at my counsel.

entries.title: Job 29:22
segments: After my words they spake not again; and my speech dropped upon them.

entries.title: Job 29:23
segments: And they waited for me as for the rain; and they opened their mouth wide [as] for the latter rain.

words.text: for me as for the rain

entries.title: Job 29:24
segments: [If] I laughed on them, they believed [it] not; and the light of my countenance they cast not down.

entries.title: Job 29:25
segments: I chose out their way, and sat chief, and dwelt as a king in the army, as one [that] comforteth the mourners.
